bio: A self-proclaimed lodge hotel for gourmets, Langwies Wirtshaus combines several facilities under one roof: a restaurant, a spa hotel, a conference centre and long-stay apartments. The menu features a contemporary selection of regional classics, steaks and seasonal dishes, as well as vegan and vegetarian options. There are several attractive dining spaces – for example, you can book a table in the cosy, spruce-panelled bay room....
